groud_truth: ∀ (a b c₁ c₂ c₃ d₁ d₂ d₃ : Point) (AB C₁₂ C₂₃ C₃₁ D₁₂ D₂₃ : Line), formTriangle c₁ c₂ c₃ C₁₂ C₂₃ C₃₁ ∧ formRectilinearAngle d₁ d₂ d₃ D₁₂ D₂₃ ∧ distinctPointsOnLine a b AB ∧ (∠ d₁:d₂:d₃ : ℝ) > 0 ∧ (∠ d₁:d₂:d₃ : ℝ) < ∟ + ∟ → ∃ (m l : Point) (BM AL ML : Line), formParallelogram b m a l BM AL AB ML ∧ (∠ a:b:m = ∠ d₁:d₂:d₃) ∧ (Triangle.area △ a:b:m + Triangle.area △ a:l:m = Triangle.area △ c₁:c₂:c₃)
